name: nGZGraphic4::FitTextureSamplerStates(filter, mip, texture) (cdecl: a 2D texture's filter and mip filter states fitted to its device's caps)
notes: Lane VU (O-c). Cdecl, three arguments. Callers: cTextureManager::SamplerStates 0xade9e0 (ours, kinds 4 and 7) and game code; hooked at the RVA. The Direct3D texture (QueryInterface 0x8b54da90, not released) through TextureFilterSupported 0x18c7f0 (ours): unsupported, both filters 0, anisotropy 1, mip filter 0, bias 0 and return. Else the caps (the texture's device, its enumeration, QueryInterface 0x6c02c311, cIDeviceEnum::GetCurrentCaps; the cIDeviceEnum released at the end): anisotropy clamped to [1, MaxAnisotropy] (unsigned); +0xc stepped against TextureFilterCaps' MAGF bits and +0xd against the MINF ones (2 to 1 without anisotropic, 1 to 0 without linear, 0 to 1 without point, in that order); a non-zero bias (NaN included) zeroed without MIPMAPLODBIAS; the mip filter 0 without TEXTURECAPS_MIPMAP, then 2 to 1 without MIPFLINEAR and 1 to 0 without MIPFPOINT; with TEXTURECAPS_POW2 a level-0 width or height not a power of two (0 counts as one; the height asked only when the width passes) sets anisotropy 1, bias 0, mip filter 0. Difftest TextureSamplerCaps_Texture (tests/gz_texture_sampler_caps.cpp, 4000 seeded cases: the support check stood in on both sides; fakes of the texture, device, enumeration face and cIDeviceEnum whose other slots note themselves; raw seeded caps words; filters 0-3 and odd bytes, anisotropy 0 / small / raw, biases 0, -0, numbers, quiet and signalling NaNs; level sizes powers of two, 0 and others; compared: the call log with arguments and both states' bytes with slack). Mutants (18 over both functions, build/vu_mut2b.json): point not raised to linear, anisotropic stepped to point, the MINF bits for +0xc, no anisotropy floor, a signed clamp, NaN bias kept, the bias zero by its bits, the mipmap check dropped, mip linear stepped to point, the height not checked, the bias kept on a non-power-of-two size, 0 not a power of two, the enumeration not released, the anisotropy kept when unsupported, the cube with MIPMAP, the cube with TextureFilterCaps, the cube running the power-of-two check, the 2D with the cube IID: 18 killed.
